events.name: Furanium Fever
events.description:
Fur, glitter, and bass — Furanium Fever is landing on Azúcar's Main Floor and it's bringing the whole pack. Tri-Cities Furs takes over the night with vendor tables to browse, drag queens ready to serve looks, and an EDM DJ keeping the floor moving from six till two.

This one's for the furry community, the furry-curious, and anyone who wants a night that doesn't look like every other Saturday. Come meet new people, vibe with the vendors, catch a drag set that turns the room electric, then lose yourself in the dance floor while the beats build all night long.

Wear your best look, bring your people, and leave the ordinary at the door. Azúcar's Main Floor is turning into a den of lights, sound, and community — 21+, doors at 6 PM, and it doesn't stop till 2 AM.

events.name: Industry Night Drag Show
events.description:
You survived the week. Now let somebody else serve you for a change. Industry Night Drag Show takes over the Main Floor this Sunday at 9pm — the one night that belongs to the bartenders, stylists, servers, and glam squad who make everyone else's nights sparkle. Rohla Blunt and Abele Fantasy host, and they know exactly who's in the room: your people, your energy, your kind of unhinged fun.

Expect the full spectacle — lip syncs, looks, and a couple of numbers that'll make you spill your drink laughing. Then things get interactive with our Best Karen Impression Contest, where brave (or delusional) volunteers battle it out for the crowd's love and a shot at tickets to Azúcar's next big nights. Bring your best entitled-customer voice. We've all got one.

Service and beauty industry folks flash your ID at the bar for special pricing all night — you've earned it. Everyone else, come through anyway; the door's open and the vibe's contagious. Sunday nights were made for recovery. We just made them better.

events.name: Emo-Night Drag Show Edition
events.description:
Dig out the studded belt and the eyeliner — your emo teen years are getting resurrected, drag-style. Sr. Knight Haven Rexia takes over the Main Floor to host a night built entirely on nostalgia: the bangers that got you through high school heartbreak, reborn as full-blown lip-sync spectacle.

Expect the hits you screamed into your pillow circa 2007, now serving looks instead of just feelings. Fishnets, smudged black lipstick, and dramatic entrances are encouraged. The performances hit hard — equal parts theatrical and unhinged, exactly how emo was always meant to be.

This is catharsis with choreography. Come mourn your Hot Topic phase, or come celebrate that it never really ended. Either way, Azúcar's Main Floor turns into one big feelings-fueled dance floor on October 10th, starting 8:30pm.

Wear black. Bring your best sad-boy stare. Leave your teenage angst on the dance floor where it belongs.

events.name: Mosh Night
events.description:
Azúcar's Main Floor is getting flipped into a pit. October 11, doors at 5pm, and the whole night belongs to the bands — hometown heavy hitters and out-of-towners stacking the bill for one loud, sweaty takeover. This isn't background music. This is amps cranked, throats raw, heads banging.

DJ Dea holds it down between sets, keeping the energy fed so the room never cools off. Expect a crowd that came to scream every word, a floor that turns into a mosh the second the first riff drops, and a bar slinging cold drinks fast because you're gonna need them.

Mosh at your own risk — we mean that. Wear something you don't mind sweating through, leave the fragile jewelry at home, and show up ready to lose your voice by last call. Every body's welcome in the pit, Latinx pride and all — just bring the chaos with you.

events.name: The Bikini Bottoms
events.description:
Somebody call the Krusty Krab, because Azúcar just got absorbent, yellow, and porous — and honestly, so are we. The Bikini Bottoms drops you straight into the deep end: SpongeBob characters strutting the runway, decor that screams pineapple-under-the-sea, and a soundtrack where Latinx beats collide head-on with your favorite Nickelodeon nostalgia. Tahboo hosts this one like the true krabby patty secret formula they are — equal parts chaos, glam, and pure camp.

Expect Squidward realness, Sandy Cheeks fierceness, maybe a Plankton villain arc or two — this Main Floor is transforming into the wildest corner of the ocean you've ever seen. The mixes are spiced, the characters are unhinged, and the drag is next level.

Dress code: full send. Come dressed as your favorite Bikini Bottom resident — best SpongeBob look of the night takes home a prize, so raid the closet and commit. This is not a night for the goofy goobers who stay home. October 22, 9PM, Main Floor — F.U.N. starts the second you walk in.

events.name: Scream Queens Drag Show
events.description:
The lights drop low and red. Somewhere a scream echoes off the walls before it turns into a laugh. This is Scream Queens — the night Azúcar's Main Floor becomes a cathedral of fog machines, sequins, and things that go bump in the night — and this year we're bringing you a face straight off your TV screen.

Arietty, Season 17 of RuPaul's Drag Race, touches down in the Tri-Cities for the very first time — and she's only the second Ru girl this city has ever seen. Latina, lethal, and dressed like she raided a haunted couture closet, Arietty brings looks that drop jaws before she even opens her mouth. This isn't hype for hype's sake — this is history walking through our doors in six-inch heels.

Rohla Blunt commands the night as your host with claws out and one-liners sharp enough to draw blood, joined by cohost Miss Jaxon making her Tri-Cities debut straight from Portland's drag underground. Victoria Amore stalks the stage with performances built to leave marks — full-bodied, jaw-dropping, the kind that make the whole room forget to breathe. Add a rotating cast of local performers hungry to steal the spotlight, and you've got a lineup stacked deeper than a coffin.

Expect glitter thick enough to bury a body in it. Expect wigs the size of tombstones and outfits that look like they cost a soul to make. Expect the kind of horror-movie theatrics that make you scream first and laugh right after. Grab a drink, find your seat on the Main Floor, and let the show do what scream queens do best — take you somewhere you didn't expect to go. October 23rd, 9PM. Doors open. The haunting begins.

events.name: Rocky horror picture drag show
events.description:
Get your rice, your cards, your toast ready — Azúcar is turning the Main Floor into Frank-N-Furter's castle for one wild night. Cherry Pop hosts a full shadow cast drag production of The Rocky Horror Picture Show, lip-syncing, strutting, and sweating through every frame while the film plays behind them. This isn't a screening — it's a ritual, and you're in the cast.

Prop bags hit every table so you can throw down at exactly the right moment — you'll know when. Sing, shout the callbacks, dance the Time Warp in the aisles. The drag is sharp, the shadow cast is tighter, and the whole room turns into one glittering, corseted fever dream from the first frame to the last.

Come in fishnets, come in a suit, come as Magenta, come as yourself — just come ready to lose your inhibitions with the rest of us. Specialty cocktails, a packed Main Floor, and Cherry Pop keeping the chaos gorgeous all night long. Antici...pation starts at 8pm on October 29. Don't be a virgin about it.
